message.content: This codebase uses lowercase comments with square-bracket annotations to enforce a consistent, machine-parseable format that pairs with type annotations or metadata extraction tools. The lowercase requirement ensures deterministic string matching across the codebase, preventing case-sensitivity bugs during static analysis or code generation passes. Square brackets (`[ ]`) are chosen because they are visually distinct from code, avoid conflicts with string literals or variable names, and clearly demarcate metadata from executable logic. This convention also makes it easy for linters and documentation generators to reliably extract comments as structured data without misinterpreting them as regular strings or expressions.
